packs.name: game-icons.net (icons/)
packs.namingConvention: kebab-case descriptive filename, one subfolder per contributing artist (lorc, delapouite, skoll, zeromancer, sbed, caro-asercion, aussiesim, darkzaitzev, faithtoken, etc.)
packs.fill/color: Every icon is a SINGLE <path> with fill="#fff" on a transparent viewBox 0 0 512 512 canvas — trivially recolorable (swap fill="#fff" for currentColor, or apply via CSS mask-image / a global find-replace). This is the main thematic icon library and the best-fit source for nearly every slot.
packs.bestUsedFor: Nav tabs, content icons, inline icons — anything needing a themeable single-color glyph.
packs.gotchas: Because it's crowd-sourced there is no single canonical 'plain' icon for common concepts (no bare heart.svg, star.svg, or gear.svg) — icons run to the specific/flavored (paw-heart, flat-star, cog) rather than generic. Attribution (CC BY 3.0) is required per-author per license.txt; a small subset are CC0 — check license.txt for the exact per-artist split before shipping.

packs.bestUsedFor: N/A — redundant, see duplicates finding below.

packs.name: vector-emojis (RhosGFX Vector Ranks Pack)
packs.path: vector-emojis/SVG/Outline/<Description>.svg and vector-emojis/SVG/No Outline/<Description>.svg (also 64px/ and 256px/ PNG renders of both variants)
packs.namingConvention: Title Case full description, e.g. 'Sleeping face.svg', 'Smiling face with hearts.svg'. Filenames contain spaces — quote paths.
packs.fill/color: Full-color emoji-style illustrations (not single-fill/currentColor-friendly) — these are baked multi-color faces, not line icons.
packs.bestUsedFor: Creature mood/expression indicators (a face overlay or care-state badge), NOT for nav/UI icons since they're multicolor and cartoon-emoji styled rather than matching the gold/ink line-icon system.

'Outline' adds a dark outline stroke to the emoji shapes; 'No Outline' is flatter/borderless — No Outline likely reads better against a dark candlelit theme.

packs.name: kenney_ui-pack (UI Pack 2.0)
packs.fileCount: ~90 unique widgets x 6 color sets (Grey/Blue/Green/Red/Yellow/Extra) in Vector; same again x2 sizes in PNG
packs.namingConvention: snake_case, color folder is the palette (not part of filename): buttons (buttonLong/buttonSquare/buttonRound + _pressed), panels, panelInset, bars (progress/health, 4 orientations), sliders, checkboxes (check_round_*, check_square_*), icon_checkmark/icon_cross/icon_outline_*, arrow_basic_*/arrow_decorative_* (n/s/e/w + _small), star.svg/star_outline.svg/star_outline_depth.svg, cursors.
packs.fill/color: BAKED hex colors with gradients/shading per SVG (not currentColor, not single-path) — e.g. star.svg uses linearGradient fills. To retheme these across the 3 dark themes you'd need to either pick a fixed color set (Grey works as a neutral base) or hand-edit the SVGs to strip gradients into flat currentColor fills.
packs.bestUsedFor: Nine-slice UI chrome (buttons, panels, sliders, checkboxes), and — notably — the ONLY source in this whole asset set with a ready-made filled/outline star pair (star.svg + star_outline.svg) and a plain right-pointing arrow (arrow_basic_e.svg) and a plain checkmark (icon_checkmark.svg / icon_outline_checkmark.svg).
packs.gotchas: Six color folders duplicate the same ~90 files six times — pick ONE color folder (Grey is most neutral for re-theming) rather than importing all six. CC0 licensed.

monsterBuilder.sourcePath: kenney_monster-builder-pack/PNG/Default/ (1x; kenney_monster-builder-pack/PNG/Double/ has the same 178 files at 2x)

body.variants: 6 colors (blue, dark, green, red, white, yellow) x 6 shapes (A-F)

arm.variants: 6 colors (blue, dark, green, red, white, yellow) x 5 shapes (A-E)

leg.variants: 6 colors (blue, dark, green, red, white, yellow) x 5 shapes (A-E)

detail.variants: 6 colors (blue, dark, green, red, white, yellow) x 7 sub-types (antenna_large, antenna_small, ear, ear_round, eye, horn_large, horn_small)

eye.variants: Not color-matched to body — style/mood variants: angry (blue/green/red = 3), solid color (blue/red/yellow = 3), closed (feminine/happy = 2), cute (dark/light = 2), dead (1), human (plain/blue/green/red = 4), psycho (dark/light = 2)

mouth.variants: 10 plain lettered shapes (mouthA.png .. mouthJ.png, no color) + 4 descriptive styles (closed_fangs, closed_happy, closed_sad, closed_teeth)

nose.variants: 4 solid colors (brown, green, red, yellow) — note this set does NOT match the body/arm/leg/detail 6-color palette (no blue/dark/white nose)

eyebrow.variants: 3 plain shapes (A, B, C), no color variants

snot.variants: large, small — an optional overlay detail (drip/bogey), not required for assembly

monsterBuilder.assemblyNotes: Layer order (back to front): body (base silhouette) -> legs (peek out from under body) -> arms (attach to body sides) -> detail (ears/horns/antennae, attach to head/body outline) -> eyes -> eyebrows -> nose -> mouth -> snot (topmost, optional). body/arm/leg/detail all share the SAME 6-color palette (blue, dark, green, red, white, yellow), so picking one color across those four categories gives a coherent monochrome creature; eye/mouth/eyebrow are mood/style selectors rather than palette-matched, and can be mixed freely on top of any body color. nose is the odd one out with only 4 colors that don't fully overlap the other categories' palette. This pack is raster-only in practice (see kenney_monster-builder-pack gotchas above) — assembly means absolutely-positioned/z-indexed or CSS background-image layers, not currentColor SVG recoloring; a creature's color is fixed by which PNG variant you pick, not adjustable via CSS.
